== Summary ==
Announcement banner for [[Scoundrels (Virtual Block 8)|Scoundrels]], release 8.1 of [[Virtual Block 8]]. It reads "Scoundrels" and "Virtual Set 8.1 - Coming May 11th, 2012" over film stills of Bossk, Han Solo, Princess Leia and Lando Calrissian. It ran in the starwarsccg.org home-page banner slideshow from April to May 2012 and linked to the "Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement" news post of 14 April 2012.

Source: [http://www.starwarsccg.org/images/banners/scoundrel3.jpg scoundrel3.jpg], starwarsccg.org (2012), 720&times;302 pixels, uploaded unchanged. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130624185150/http://www.starwarsccg.org/images/banners/scoundrel3.jpg Internet Archive].

Home page showing the banner: [http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org] (10 May 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120510015711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive].

News post: [http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement], starwarsccg.org (14 April 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111311/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].
